translations.web: Who is there among you who will give ear to this? Who will listen and hear for the time to come?
translations.bsb: Who among you will pay attention to this? Who will listen and obey hereafter?
translations.kjv: Who among you will give ear to this? who will hearken and hear for the time to come?
translations.asv: Who is there among you that will give ear to this? that will hearken and hear for the time to come?
